keyphasor: single notch in the shaft; zero of the 1X phase
speed: speed_rpm is taken from the turbine speed pickup on a 60-tooth wheel; after the run the monitor's speed input was found configured for 59 teeth

probes.de_y: DE bearing, Y: 45 deg right of top, looking from the driver
probes.nde_x: NDE bearing, X: 45 deg left of top, looking from the driver
probes.nde_y: NDE bearing, Y: 45 deg right of top, looking from the driver

supports: tilting-pad journal bearings in pedestals cast into the concrete block
probe_type: proximity probe systems, 7.87 V/mm; gap voltage healthy from -8 to -12 V
data: 1X vectors (um pk-pk, deg lag) tracked by the plant's online monitoring system
